name: Legendy Savvary: Deti Solnca
source:
Once upon a time, Savvarah was a desolate land: icy winds, a dirty canvas of clouds, lifeless earth.

Nueli witnessed nothing of the kind. She was born in a blooming paradise. The tales of the past had transformed into a kind of fable. Almost a myth.

From her birth, Nueli had a serious flaw – a weak aptitude for magic, an extraordinarily rare occurrence for her people. Unable to use magic, she could see more than others – the very threads magic was woven from.

And since her very childhood, she began to see darkness. A darkness dotted with eyes, watching over her… yet nobody could see these gloomy shadows besides her.

Nueli is set to unravel the mysteries of her visions, learn more about the history of her people, become part of a conspiracy, find herself at the very center of the confrontation between divine entities... Or not. Everything is in your hands.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416490/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
曾几何时，萨瓦拉是一片荒凉的土地：冰冷的风、肮脏的云彩、死气沉沉的大地。

努埃里没有目睹任何类似的事情。她出生在一个盛开的天堂。过去的故事已经变成了一种寓言。几乎是一个神话。

努埃丽从出生起就有一个严重的缺陷——魔法天赋较弱，这对于她的族人来说是极其罕见的。由于无法使用魔法，她比其他人能看到更多——魔法的编织线。

从她很小的时候起，她就开始看到黑暗。黑暗布满了眼睛，注视着她……但除了她之外，没有人能看到这些阴暗的阴影。

努埃莉将揭开她幻象的奥秘，更多地了解她人民的历史，成为阴谋的一部分，发现自己处于神圣实体之间对抗的中心……或者不是。一切都在你的手中。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416490/]Steam[/url]]
